## Projects

- [Grimo](https://github.com/diegorezm/grimo): A social network for readers with shelves, reviews, a feed and a monthly reading recap. Web and mobile, running on Cloudflare. TypeScript. In development.
- [Pomolotl](https://github.com/diegorezm/pomolotl): A cozy Pomodoro timer for Windows, Linux and macOS with an axolotl companion. Lives in the system tray and has a floating timer. Rust and egui. Released. Website: https://diegorezm.github.io/pomolotl/
- [Meu Edital](https://github.com/diegorezm/meu-edital): A free study app for Brazilian public exams that builds a study cycle from the weight of each subject in the exam notice and turns studying into a game. TypeScript on Cloudflare. Waitlist open.
- [Leme](https://github.com/diegorezm/leme): A fast, minimal, local-first PDF reader for Windows. Rust and Slint. Released.
- [dresume](https://github.com/diegorezm/dresume): Resume workspaces powered by Typst: one template, many resumes. Desktop app and CLI built for AI agents. Rust. Released.
- [dcom](https://github.com/diegorezm/dcom): Lightweight, self-hostable community chat with a native Rust desktop client and a Convex backend. Beta.
- [proposal-skill](https://github.com/diegorezm/proposal-skill): A Claude Code skill that turns an AI's plan into a one-page visual proposal a person can review in a minute.
- [KVCluster](https://github.com/diegorezm/KVCluster): A distributed key-value store built from scratch in Java, inspired by Redis. Study project.

## Learning path

- [Distributed Engineering Learning Path](https://diegorezm.github.io/distributed-eng-learning-path/): A 22-week public roadmap from failure models to a complete distributed product: basic replication, Raft, a fault-tolerant key-value store, sharding, messaging and observability. Not started yet.
